openQuestions: Q3 results (to December 2026, due by mid-February): does the gross margin recover from 24% (26–28% a year earlier)?
Does inventory (Rs 19.1bn) start to fall and release cash, and are the Rs 4.4bn of short-term loans repaid?
Exchange gains and losses: a Rs 590mn gain in Q1 then a Rs 144mn loss in Q2; how big is the swing next quarter?
Copper price direction and its effect on stock values (not covered in the interim reports).
Exports (Rs 6.23bn in six months, up 46%): can the growth continue?
Second-half EPS against the base case of about Rs 4.39 (Rs 4.52 a year earlier).

changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/update ACL.N0000 COCO.N0000 DIST.N0000 HAYL.N0000 JINS.N0000 RHL.N0000). Updated from the interim report to 30 September 2026. Quarter flat: revenue up 26% to Rs 14.30bn, gross margin 23.8% (26.5%), Rs 144mn exchange loss, EPS Rs 2.04 (Rs 2.06); six months EPS Rs 4.61 (Rs 4.30). NAV Rs 55.46 (Rs 54.04 in June). Inventory Rs 19.08bn, operating cash flow minus Rs 4.66bn for the half, short-term loans Rs 4.43bn, net cash about Rs 10.4bn. Dividend Rs 0.60 for 2025/26 paid 26 Oct 2026. No valuation inputs changed; no restatements found. Fair value Rs 63.50 → 64.70 only from the higher NAV (P/B and residual income). Fair value Rs 64.70, buy Rs 55.00, strong buy Rs 48.50; price Rs 101.50 (CSE close 13 Nov 2026). Business tests 3 of 4 (fails cash), category 2 watch list, unchanged. Note: the 11 Nov residual-income bull case used a starting ROE of 19% (18% in bear and base); kept and now stated. Copper prices not in the report, so not assessed.
